name: Ji-Haw Industrial Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ji-Haw Industrial Co., Ltd. operates as a prominent entity focused on the research, production, and distribution of a wide array of information technology and communication cords and connectors. Its operational footprint extends across Taiwan, mainland China, and Thailand. The company's diverse product portfolio encompasses both internal and external electronic cabling solutions, versatile single and multi-function dongles, low voltage differential signaling (LVDS) cables, and flexible flat cables. Beyond general IT applications, Ji-Haw also supplies passive fiber optics components and specialized wiring harnesses for the automotive sector. These automotive solutions include cables for door panels, parking sensors, reverse imaging systems, seat heating mechanisms, general electrical systems, and shift transmission units. Furthermore, their offerings extend to a comprehensive range of audio and video cables, such as DVI, DisplayPort, HDMI, and VGA types. They also manufacture critical components like ceramic ferrules for fiber optic connectors, alongside fiber optic patch cords, and various products for digital multimedia and IT devices. Founded in 1983, Ji-Haw Industrial maintains its corporate headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
